_design_notes: CONTRIVED TEST CONFIG: Forces Brawl/unarmed combat to verify unarmed weapon mapping. WWE-style void wrestling championship. No ranged weapons, no melee weapons — only fists and shock batons. Characters have high Brawl, low/no Guns.
_scenario_hint: Underground void wrestling championship in a converted cargo hold. Two tag-team wrestlers face off against rival tag team. Rules: no weapons, no guns, no blades — bare knuckles and body slams only. The ring is surrounded by howling Freeborn spectators betting soulcredit. Announcer hypes every move. Wrestling moves encouraged: suplexes, piledrivers, clotheslines, submission holds, top-rope dives. This is entertainment, not a deathmatch — STUN damage only.

initial_enemies.name: The Void Crushers
initial_enemies.spawn_reason: Rival tag team in the void wrestling championship

starting_clocks.name: Crowd Hype
starting_clocks.description: The crowd goes wild with every big move. Max hype = legendary match.
starting_clocks.advance_meaning: Spectacular wrestling moves, dramatic reversals, crowd-pleasing showmanship
starting_clocks.regress_meaning: Boring rest holds, stalling, crowd losing interest

starting_clocks.name: Referee Patience
starting_clocks.description: Illegal moves (eye gouges, low blows) tick this down. At 0 the ref calls a DQ.
starting_clocks.advance_meaning: Clean wrestling, following the rules, ref regains confidence
starting_clocks.regress_meaning: Illegal moves spotted — eye gouges, low blows, foreign objects

players.name: Macho Vex Savage

personality.description: A showboating powerhouse wrestler who lives for the crowd's roar. Calls himself 'The Cream of the Void.' Loves suplexes, elbow drops, and cutting promos mid-fight. Tags in his partner with dramatic flair.

goals: Win the Void Wrestling Championship belt
Land the most spectacular top-rope move of the night
Never break character — always be the Macho Vex

players.name: Vessel Sera 'The Snake' Karsel

personality.description: A technical submission specialist who wraps opponents in joint locks and chokeholds. Plays the cunning heel — distracts the ref while her partner cheats. Quick, agile, fights dirty when needed.

goals: Lock in a devastating submission hold for the win
Distract the referee so Macho Vex can use illegal moves
Make the crowd hate her (good heat is still heat)

notes: CONTRIVED TEST: Void wrestling championship. Forces Brawl/unarmed combat — no ranged or melee weapons available. Verifies unarmed weapon mapping in dm.py.
